name: selkie-intro
title: Meet the SELKIE, Scotland's Seal-Folk 🦭 #shorts
description:
In the folklore of Orkney and Shetland, a selkie is a seal in the sea that can shed its skin and walk on land as a person. Steal the skin and she is stuck, find it again and she is gone with the waves. Seals really do haul out on rocky shores, and one theory says people in sealskin kayaks were mistaken for seal-folk.

Would you hide the skin or give it back? 👇
